# Conditions Encyclopedia

## Status Conditions

| Condition | Effect | Duration | Removal |
|-----------|--------|----------|--------|
| Blinded | Cannot see, auto-fail sight checks, attacks have disadvantage, attacks against have advantage | Until removed | Lesser Restoration |
| Charmed | Cannot attack charmer, charmer has advantage on social checks | Until removed | Lesser Restoration |
| Deafened | Cannot hear, auto-fail hearing checks | Until removed | Lesser Restoration |
| Frightened | Disadvantage on ability/saves while source in sight, cannot willingly move closer to source | Until removed | Lesser Restoration |
| Grappled | Speed becomes 0, condition ends if grappler incapacitated or moved out of reach | Until removed | Action to escape, incapacitate grappler |
| Incapacitated | Cannot take actions/reactions | Until removed | - |
| Invisible | Cannot be seen (but can hear), attacks have advantage, attacks against have disadvantage | Until removed | Lesser Restoration |
| Paralyzed | Incapacitated, cannot move/speak, automatically critical hit if damaged, vulnerability to critters | Until removed | Greater Restoration |
| Petrified | Transformed to stone, weight x10, incapacitated, immune to poison/disease, unconscious, resistance to all damage | Until removed | Greater Restoration |
| Poisoned | Disadvantage on attack rolls/ability checks | Until removed | Lesser Restoration |
| Prone | Crawling movement only, melee attacks have disadvantage, ranged have advantage, melee against have advantage | Until removed | Stand up (half movement) |
| Restrained | Speed 0, attacks have disadvantage, attacks against have advantage, DEX saves have disadvantage | Until removed | Lesser Restoration |
| Stunned | Incapacitated, cannot speak, automatically fail STR/DEX saves, attacks against have advantage | Until removed | Greater Restoration |
| Unconscious | Incapacitated, cannot move/speak, automatically fall prone, unable to perceive, unconscious | Until removed | - |
| Exhaustion | Levels stack 1-6, cumulative penalties | Long rest removes 1 | Various |

## Exhaustion Levels

| Level | Effect |
|--------|--------|
| 1 | Disadvantage on ability checks |
| 2 | Speed halved |
| 3 | Disadvantage on attack rolls/saves |
| 4 | Max HP halved |
| 5 | Speed reduced to 0 |
| 6 | Death |
